load_image: load an image file as a normalized float32 numpy array with EXIF rotation correction
resize_to_target: resize a numpy image array to a target max dimension with optional alignment rounding
load_raw_float32_image: load a raw float32 binary image file written by C++ CvUtil freadimg
save_raw_float32_image: save a numpy float32 image array to a raw binary file readable by C++ CvUtil
save_image: save a normalized float32 image array to a PNG JPG or raw binary file
